watching_for: I am watching to see if the 'Pig Booster' is a consistent cross-sector phenomenon, if 'Scenic Narratives' consistently trigger a penalty, and if explicit mentions of previous loan expiration (vulnerability/urgency) act as a speed booster.

pitches-that-mention-owning-a-home-or-la.title: Pitches that mention owning a home or land fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-mention-owning-a-home-or-la.body: Explicitly mentioning home ownership as proof of stability (e.g., 'home is proof of her stability') provides a tangible signal of low risk to lenders.

pitches-that-include-specific-personal-d.title: Pitches that provide quantifiable professional data fund faster than those providing only personal demographics, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-include-specific-personal-d.body: While age and number of children can help, specific business data (years of experience, specific product lists) is a more consistent predictor of speed.

pitches-that-include-unique-narrative-el.title: Pitches that include unique narrative elements like personal history or specific locations fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-include-unique-narrative-el.body: Replacing templated phrases like 'hardworking entrepreneur' with specific details (e.g., 'fled Sudan’s war' or 'farmer from Matuu') creates a stronger connection with lenders.

pitches-that-replace-vague-aspirations-o.title: Pitches that replace vague aspirations or generic demographics with concrete, quantifiable data—such as specific asset lists, professional experience, or educational milestones—fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-replace-vague-aspirations-o.body: Quantification transforms a pitch from a generic request for help into a tangible business plan, increasing lender confidence by making the loan's purpose and the borrower's capacity verifiable.

pitches-that-include-explicit-expression.title: Pitches that include explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-include-explicit-expression.body: Explicitly thanking lenders within the pitch text creates a personal connection and signals a polite, appreciative borrower, which may accelerate funding.

pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-identi.title: Pitches that identify the borrower's business as fish-related fund slower than other business types, regardless of sector or gender.
pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-identi.body: Borrowers involved in fishing or fish-vending fund slower than those in other sectors (like vegetable or fruit vending), suggesting a general lender bias against fish-related micro-enterprises.

pitches-that-use-high-tech-or-abstract-e.title: Pitches that use high-tech or abstract environmental framing fund slower than those using simple business goals, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-use-high-tech-or-abstract-e.body: Language focusing on 'renewable energy', 'greenhouse gases', or specific technical equipment like 'biodigesters' appears to be a slow signal, possibly due to perceived risk or lack of urgency.

in-pair-6-l3159981-vs-l3159909-the-pitch.body: In Pair 6 (L3159981 vs L3159909), the pitches are nearly identical in structure, tone, and goal, differing only in the business type ('general store' vs 'fish cultivation'). The general store funded 42 hours faster, suggesting business sector preference may override textual features in some cases.

there-is-a-tension-between-formal-grant-.body: There is a tension between 'formal/grant-like' language (Slow, L3158839) and 'deeply personal/emotive' narrative (Fast, L3162145). Both are 'non-business' text, but one is abstract/idealistic and the other is concrete/hardship-based.

in-pair-2-l3160527-vs-l3156657-the-pitch.body: In Pair 2 (L3160527 vs L3156657), the pitches are virtually identical, yet the one with a clothing business funded significantly faster than the one with a sugarcane business.

in-pair-6-l3161083-vs-l3156686-a-man-fun.body: In Pair 6 (L3161083 vs L3156686), a man funded faster than a woman despite both using very generic, templated language. This suggests that certain identifiers ('widower', 'rice farm') may carry disproportionate weight for men, or that the gender baseline is mitigated by specific sectors.

in-pair-4-l3159376-vs-l3158742-the-faste.body: In Pair 4 (L3159376 vs L3158742), the faster pitch is a generic template, while the slower pitch contains specific personal hardships (widow, age 53). This contradicts the general trend that quantifiable personal data and unique narratives accelerate funding.

in-pair-3-l3160935-vs-l3158231-the-faste.body: In Pair 3 (L3160935 vs L3158231), the faster pitch actually uses the 'secure her family's future' template, which usually predicts slow funding. However, it is surrounded by emotive language ('working tirelessly'), while the slow pitch is purely factual. This suggests that the template penalty may be overridden by an emotive narrative, or that a complete lack of narrative is the strongest 'slow' signal.

the-template-penalty-is-extremely-preval.body: The 'template penalty' is extremely prevalent in loans from the NWTF partner (Philippines). I wonder if lenders have developed a subconscious bias against the specific phrasing used by certain field partners.

in-pair-4-l3159345-vs-l3160543-the-pitch.body: In Pair 4 (L3159345 vs L3160543), the pitches are virtually identical except for a single word ('and') and a small loan amount difference, yet the faster loan funded 26 hours earlier. This suggests a threshold where small amount differences or invisible metadata may override text.

in-pair-2-l3160705-vs-l3158958-the-pitch.body: In Pair 2 (L3160705 vs L3158958), the pitches are functionally identical, yet there is a 51-hour difference. This suggests that for very similar text, other factors (perhaps loan amount precision or partner-specific noise) dominate.

in-pair-3-l3160546-vs-l3156741-a-generic.body: In Pair 3 (L3160546 vs L3156741), a generic template funded significantly faster than a pitch with demographics. This suggests that demographics are not a 'booster' but a baseline, and the absence of a compelling narrative is the real 'slow' signal.

in-pair-1-l3159142-vs-l3156899-the-faste.body: In Pair 1 (L3159142 vs L3156899), the faster pitch is actually more generic than the slower one. The slower pitch provides more personal data (seven children) but also uses 'environmental protection' language. This suggests the 'grant-like language' penalty is stronger than the 'demographic data' bonus.

the-nwtf-template-paradox-in-pairs-1-3-a.body: The NWTF Template Paradox: In Pairs 1, 3, and 5, the most basic, pure template ('secure the future of the family') funded faster than pitches that attempted to be more specific ('expand her business' or 'build and develop'). Why is the pure template more effective than a slightly modified one?

in-pair-4-l3159096-vs-l3161289-the-faste.body: In Pair 4 (L3159096 vs L3161289), the faster pitch includes framing about 'neighbors' and 'environmental protection' in a sanitation loan. I wonder if community/environmental impact framing is a specific booster for the sanitation sector, or a general booster.

the-sanitation-framing-flip-in-batch-12-.body: The Sanitation Framing Flip: In Batch 12, 'environmental protection' and 'neighbors' framing was a booster for sanitation loans. In Batch 13 (Pairs 5 and 7), this same phrasing was associated with significantly slower funding compared to pitches focusing solely on family health risks.

the-demographic-drag-in-pair-1-a-pure-te.body: The Demographic Drag: In Pair 1, a pure template funded faster than a template supplemented with personal demographics (age, widowhood, number of children). This suggests that generic demographics may be a 'slow' signal if they are not integrated into a unique narrative.

the-emotive-template-vs-pure-template-di.body: The 'Emotive Template' vs 'Pure Template' distinction: In previous batches, pure templates ('secure the future of the family') were seen as a baseline or even a booster in some NWTF loans. However, this batch shows a consistent 'slow' signal for a more florid version of the template ('working tirelessly toward the attainment of her dream'). I need to determine if the 'pure' template is neutral and the 'emotive' template is negative.

the-specificity-paradox-in-pair-4-loan-l.body: The Specificity Paradox: In Pair 4, Loan L3161431 is exceptionally specific (38 years experience, 5 employees, specific crops) yet funded significantly slower than the generic template in L3161059. Because these loans are from different countries (Rwanda vs Philippines), I suspect country-level baseline speed or partner-specific lender bias is overriding the textual benefit of specificity.

in-pair-6-two-pitches-using-the-same-wor.body: In Pair 6, two pitches using the same 'working tirelessly' emotive template differed only in their goal: 'secure the future of her family' (Fast) vs 'expand her business' (Slow). This suggests that within a templated pitch, family-centric goals may be more effective than business-centric goals.

in-pair-3-secure-her-family-s-livelihood.body: In Pair 3, 'secure her family's livelihood' (vague) beat 'send her children to college' (specific). This contradicts the general specificity booster, suggesting that certain 'template goals' like college may be perceived as less urgent or more generic than family survival.

in-sanitation-loans-does-entrepreneur-fr.body: In sanitation loans, does 'entrepreneur' framing (L3162225, L3162019) fund faster than 'struggling parent' framing (L3157156, L3157163) when environmental fluff is removed?

does-the-mention-of-specific-social-repa.body: Does the mention of specific 'social repayment' (e.g., volunteering as a CAMFED Guide in L3162076) act as a powerful speed booster independent of other features?

in-pair-8-a-descriptive-narrative-by-a-m.body: In Pair 8, a descriptive narrative by a man (L3159740) about 'color, detail, and meaning' in his art lost to a generic female template (L3159441). This suggests that not all unique narratives are equal; 'artistic' or 'aesthetic' narratives may not provide the same urgency or trust signal as 'hardship' or 'labor-intensive' narratives (like those in Pairs 6 and 7).

the-working-tirelessly-template-paradox-.body: The 'Working Tirelessly' template paradox: In Pair 3, this template funds significantly faster than a factual pitch. In Pair 7, it funds significantly slower than a simple factual pitch. In Pair 1, it funds slower than a concrete goal. Is the template a neutral baseline that allows other small features to dominate, or is its effect sector-dependent?

in-sanitation-loans-pairs-2-and-5-the-te.body: In sanitation loans (Pairs 2 and 5), the text is virtually identical, yet speed varies by 55+ hours. This suggests that the specific business type mentioned (cosmetics vs food-vending, pig fattening vs clothing) may be a hidden speed driver.

in-sanitation-loans-there-is-a-recurring.body: In sanitation loans, there is a recurring pattern where 'pig fattening' (L3161702, L3157391, L3157142) funds fast, while 'general store' (L3157224, L3157235) funds slow, even when other text is identical.

the-environmental-protection-penalty-in-.body: The 'Environmental Protection' penalty in sanitation loans appears to be inconsistent; it slowed L3159425 but was present in the fast loans L3157391 and L3157142. Is the penalty actually a 'General Store' penalty in disguise?

in-pair-8-the-slow-pitch-l3161336-is-an-.body: In Pair 8, the slow pitch (L3161336) is an environmental project (biodigester) and funds slower than a simple manure request. This suggests the 'environmental penalty' observed in sanitation loans might be a general trend for high-tech or abstract environmental framing across sectors.

in-sanitation-loans-pig-fattening-was-pr.body: In sanitation loans, 'pig fattening' was previously seen as a booster, but in Pairs 5 and 8 it was the slower loan. Is the business-type effect in sanitation loans highly volatile or dependent on the partner?

in-pair-1-l3162207-vs-l3158762-the-pitch.body: In Pair 1 (L3162207 vs L3158762), the pitches are virtually identical, differing only by the word 'and' in the phrase 'health and hazard risks'. Despite this, there is a 47-hour funding gap, suggesting that for highly templated text, invisible metadata or random noise dominates.

in-pair-4-the-fast-general-store-l315713.body: In Pair 4, the fast general store (L3157135) mentions 'neighbors' and 'environmental protection', while the slow general store (L3158772) does not. This suggests that in the sanitation sector, environmental framing may actually be a booster, contradicting some previous observations.

in-sanitation-loans-general-store-is-som.body: In sanitation loans, 'general store' is sometimes fast (Pair 2, 3, 5) and sometimes slow (Pair 1, 4). This suggests it is a neutral baseline, and the real speed drivers are environmental framing (Fast) or fish-vending (Slow).

in-pair-4-a-highly-descriptive-scenic-na.body: In Pair 4, a highly descriptive, 'scenic' narrative about a district's beauty and gastronomy (L3159818) was significantly slower than a generic emotive template (L3159061). This suggests a 'Scenic Penalty' where narratives that feel like travel brochures rather than urgent requests for capital are viewed unfavorably.

in-loan-l3161185-the-borrower-explicitly.body: In Loan L3161185, the borrower explicitly mentions that their last loan request expired before getting funded. I wonder if this kind of transparency/vulnerability acts as a speed booster by signaling urgency to the lender.

pitches-that-specify-a-concrete-number-o.title: Pitches that specify a concrete number of years of experience fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-specify-a-concrete-number-o.retrospective: Consolidated into a broader claim about quantifiable data to increase parsimony.

pitches-that-mention-specific-educationa.title: Pitches that describe the current schooling status of children fund faster than those that mention a generic dream of college, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-mention-specific-educationa.retrospective: Consolidated into a broader claim about quantifiable data to increase parsimony.

pitches-that-disclose-specific-income-fi.title: Pitches that disclose specific income figures or loan repayment history fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-disclose-specific-income-fi.retrospective: Consolidated into a broader claim about quantifiable data to increase parsimony.

pitches-that-describe-specific-social-co.title: Pitches that describe specific social commitments or community service as part of the loan agreement fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-describe-specific-social-co.retrospective: Evicted to maintain the proposition cap of 8. It remained orthogonal for several batches and was the lowest confidence claim.

pitches-that-mention-previous-financial-.title: Pitches that mention previous financial success, such as saving profits, fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-mention-previous-financial-.retrospective: Auto-evicted to honor the 8-claim cap: this was the lowest-confidence claim at 0.65.

pitches-by-men-that-mention-previous-fin.title: Pitches by men that mention previous financial success, such as saving profits or successful repayment, fund faster than those that do not.
pitches-by-men-that-mention-previous-fin.retrospective: Auto-evicted to honor the 8-claim cap: this was the lowest-confidence claim at 0.65.

pitches-that-use-templated-phrases-such-.title: Pitches that use templated phrases such as 'secure the future of her family' fund slower, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-use-templated-phrases-such-.retrospective: I believed these phrases were 'low-effort' signals. However, in the Philippines/NWTF context, they appear to be a baseline of legitimacy or are simply ignored by lenders.

pitches-that-use-formal-grant-like-langu.title: Pitches that use formal, grant-like language to describe community or environmental impact fund slower, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-use-formal-grant-like-langu.retrospective: I thought 'environmental protection' and 'community' language felt too impersonal. Pair 4 proves that these markers can actually accelerate funding in sanitation sectors.

pitches-that-specify-a-concrete-quantity.title: Pitches that specify concrete quantities or detailed lists of assets to be purchased fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-specify-a-concrete-quantity.retrospective: Consolidated into the broader quantification claim to increase parsimony.

pitches-that-specify-concrete-future-goa.title: Pitches that specify concrete future goals, such as specific educational milestones, fund faster than those using generic aspirational language, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-specify-concrete-future-goa.retrospective: Consolidated into the broader quantification claim to increase parsimony.

pitches-that-use-generic-highly-emotive-.title: Pitches that use generic, highly emotive phrases such as 'working tirelessly toward the attainment of her dream' fund slower, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-use-generic-highly-emotive-.retrospective: I believed the 'working tirelessly' template was a slow signal. This batch shows it actually beats bare-bones factual pitches, though it still loses to high-specificity narratives. It is a 'middle' signal, not a 'slow' one.

pitches-that-describe-a-specific-non-fin.title: Pitches that describe a specific, non-financial social repayment commitment fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-describe-a-specific-non-fin.retrospective: Retired to make room for the 'General Store' sanitation penalty, which showed stronger consistency in this batch. The social repayment claim remained orthogonal for several batches.

pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-mentio.title: Pitches for sanitation loans that mention environmental protection or community benefits fund slower than those focusing solely on family health risks.
pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-mentio.retrospective: I believed environmental framing was a penalty in sanitation. This batch showed it present in the majority of fast sanitation loans, suggesting it is neutral or a booster.

pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-identi.title: Pitches for sanitation loans that identify the borrower's business as a 'general store' fund slower than those identifying other business types, regardless of gender.
pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-identi.retrospective: I believed 'general store' was a slow signal in sanitation. Pair 8 proves this wrong with a 0.6h funding time for a general store.

pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-mentio.title: Pitches for sanitation loans that mention environmental protection or community benefits fund slower than those focusing solely on family health risks, regardless of gender.
pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-mentio.retrospective: I believed environmental framing was a penalty in sanitation. This batch showed it present in both fast and slow loans, proving it is noise rather than a signal.

pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-identi.title: Pitches for sanitation loans that identify the borrower's business as a 'general store' fund slower than those identifying more specific business types, regardless of gender.
pitches-for-sanitation-loans-that-identi.retrospective: I believed general stores in sanitation were a slow signal. However, Pair 1 and Pair 4 show them funding much faster than fish-related businesses or basic templates, suggesting the 'slow' signal was actually the fish business, not the general store.

pitches-follow-a-funding-speed-hierarchy.title: Pitches follow a funding speed hierarchy based on textual register, where unique personal narratives fund fastest, followed by emotive templates, with purely factual or generic pitches funding slowest, regardless of gender.
pitches-follow-a-funding-speed-hierarchy.retrospective: I believed narrative register (unique > emotive > factual) was the key. However, this batch shows that a 'factual template' with a repayment track record beats a 'unique narrative' without one.

pitches-that-explicitly-mention-a-histor.title: Pitches that explicitly mention a history of successful previous loans fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-explicitly-mention-a-histor.retrospective: I believed previous loan history was a strong booster. However, in the NWTF/Philippines context, it appears to be a standard part of the template for almost all borrowers, regardless of funding speed.

pitches-that-mention-existing-customer-d.title: Pitches that mention existing customer demand or specific orders fund faster, regardless of gender.
pitches-that-mention-existing-customer-d.retrospective: Evicted to honor the 8-claim cap. This was the lowest-confidence claim and remained orthogonal in the current batch.
